intro_title: How the Bad Day Balls Challenge Works
intro_message:
You can play one time a day when the game is active. (active days are randomized)
5 shots. Your closest shot to the pin is the one that counts.
Hole-in-one wins a free sleeve of balls (or 15% off instead).
Inside 10 ft earns 10% off. Inside 20 ft earns 5% off.
Finish all 5 shots and we email your code and the link straight to you.
Your code is live for 24 hours, so grab your Bad Day Balls while it lasts.
